text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally the day of Yamanin Zephyr's debut race.
choice_data_list: Your body's not feeling stiff or anything, right?
Your body's not feeling stiff or anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The question slips out. Official races are on a completely different level from the scrimmages at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having to race before so many eyes, all seeking to measure her worth, while surrounded by opponents each determined to become a legend in their own—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, it feels the same as always—akin to a harmonious breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like she has no nerves whatsoever… which is a relief.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To be fair, she has always beat to her own drum… I guess she just isn't bothered by the public gaze in general.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I know exactly what I have to do on the turf—I simply have to become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Being able to focus on that alone is a most auspicious updraft… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes on me, Trainer. Watch as I beckon the first winds of spring!
